text:
The 2021 tree-cover loss on this property is now corroborated. The latest run (run-2, 12 Nov 2026) found 81.3 ha of loss in 2021, or 2.23% of the 3,643.5 ha asset.

Corroboration rests on two conditions:
- **Later years observed:** the series now runs through 2025. In the earlier run (May 2022), the latest observed year was 2021, so the event could not yet be corroborated.
- **JRC 2020 agreement:** 98% of the event area was mapped as forest in 2020, well above the 50% threshold.

Forest type (MGAP 2021 map):
- 68.1 ha was planted pine (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*).
- 13.2 ha was outside mapped forest.
- No native forest was affected (0 ha).

A further 37.3 ha of 2021 loss was in patches under 0.5 ha. It is not counted as an event.

The loss figures are identical across both runs. Only the corroboration status changed.
